name: feature.discovery.nodes
description: Discovery feature node pack (MERCH-C chat-drivability) — nodes over the ctx.features.discovery surface. `search` runs faceted product search; `collection-upsert` authors a manual/dynamic collection; `merch-rule-upsert` authors a pin/boost/bury/hide rule. Collections/rules carry no money and are reversible ⇒ direct agent authoring. All role:'action' (recorded → replay-safe over the mutable catalog).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Discovery Search
nodes.description: Faceted product search (optional collection scope) over ctx.features.discovery. role:'action' (recorded — the catalog is mutable). Inputs: orgId, q?, collectionId?.

nodes.label: Discovery Collection Upsert
nodes.description: Authors a collection — manual (productIds) or dynamic (rule by category/tag/price). Inputs: orgId, name, type, productIds?|rule?.

nodes.label: Discovery Merch-Rule Upsert
nodes.description: Authors a merchandising rule (pin/boost/bury/hide over a query/collection scope) with optional holdout. Inputs: orgId, name, scope, actions:[…], holdoutPct?.
